title: 第1章 青云梯前烤铃薯万阶独引我凤鸣第2章 测灵根
slug: 满级师妹她缺德但能打
content_zh:
青云山脉，亘古矗立，云雾缥缈间，仙鹤清唳，衔日穿云。
今日，正是修仙界巨头青云宗十年一度开山收徒之大典。
山门外汉白玉铺就的巨广场上，早已人声鼎沸，数千名怀揣仙缘梦想的少年少女翘首以盼，目光无不炽热地投向那道宛若通天的庞然巨物——青云梯，又称问心阶。
九千九百九十九级汉白玉阶梯，蜿蜒而上，直没入茫茫云海，尽头隐约可见仙家宫阙的琉璃瓦反射着天光。
此阶非寻常石阶，其上蕴含宗门大能布下的重重威压与直指本心的幻灭大阵，专为考校求道者的心性、毅力与根骨潜质，乃青云宗筛选弟子的第一道，亦是淘汰率最高的无情铁槛。
历来能踏足顶端者，百中无一，皆为人中龙凤，前途不可限量。
广场边缘，一个与周遭郑重、紧张、兴奋氛围格格不入的身影，正蹲在墙角，专心致志地捣鼓着一个简易的小土窑。
那是个看起来约莫十五六岁的少女，穿着一身洗得发白、甚至有些宽大的粗布衣裳，一根再普通不过的木簪随意绾着头发，几缕不听话的发丝垂在耳边，随着她的动作轻轻晃动。
她眉眼灵动，此刻正小心翼翼地将几片边缘呈赤红色、散发着微弱热力的奇异叶子垫在土窑底部，嘴里嘀嘀咕咕：
“嗯…三百年份左右的‘炽焰草’叶子，火力温润持久还带点甜香，烤出来的薯才外焦里嫩，灵气不散…啧，大宗门就是底蕴厚实，门口当景观的杂草都这么讲究，不薅…不是，不借用几片简直对不起这份天赐的机缘。”
她动作熟练地将几个沾着新鲜泥土、婴儿拳头大小的暗红色块茎埋进土窑，引火点燃那炽焰草叶。
很快，一股奇异的甜香混合着淡淡的火灵气弥漫开来，与广场上严肃期待的氛围形成了诡异却又莫名和谐的对比。
周围几个等待考核的少年忍不住频频侧目，面露鄙夷与不解。
这都什么时候了？仙缘当前，还在搞这些口腹之欲？而且那是什么东西？从哪儿挖出来的？
一个身着云纹锦缎、腰佩灵光隐隐玉佩的少年，终是忍不住冷哼一声，语气带着十足的优越与嫌恶：“喂！
那个谁！
你是来参加青云宗考核的还是来野外打牙祭的？此地乃仙家重地，庄严肃穆，注意点你的仪容行止！
真是岂有此理！”
少女闻声抬头，腮帮子居然已经鼓囊起来（不知何时已偷吃了一个），眨巴着一双清澈却又似乎总带着点迷糊困意的眼睛，含糊道：“仪容？行止？兄嘚，这你就不懂了吧？吃饱了才有力气爬楼梯啊！
这可是实打实的体力活！

看你这细皮嫩肉的，待会儿别饿哭了。
来一个不？刚出炉的‘地脉薯’，富含火土灵气，嘎嘎香！”
她无比自然地递过去一个烤得黢黑、还沾着些许草木灰的块茎，热情得好似街边摊贩。
那锦衣少年被那卖相堪忧的“炭块”
吓了一跳，仿佛怕被穷酸气沾染般猛地后退两步，嫌恶道：“谁要吃你这来历不明的脏东西！
不知所谓！
乡野村姑，毫无体统！”
少女也不恼，耸耸肩，无比自然地收回手，“咔嚓”
自己咬了一大口，烫得直吸溜气，却一脸满足地眯起眼：“唉，山猪吃不了细糠，没口福哟。”
锦衣少年气得脸色发红，正要再斥，却被一道骤然响彻广场、恢弘沉静如同古钟轰鸣的声音打断。
“肃静！”
一位身着青云宗执事青袍、面容古拙、目光如冷电的中年修士，无声无息地出现在青云梯最前方的高台之上。
广场上瞬间落针可闻，所有嘈杂议论被一股无形的威压悄然压下。
“青云梯开，问道之心！”
修士声音不高，却字字清晰，重重敲在每个人心头，“日落为限，登顶者，方可进入下一轮考核！
途中不得借助法器符箓，不得互相争斗扶持，违者，立即逐出，永不复测！”
“登梯——开始！”
话音如落石坠湖，激起千层浪！
早已蓄势待发的人群如同开闸的汹涌洪流，嘶喊着、争先恐后地涌向那漫长的汉白玉阶梯。
热血与野心在这一刻燃烧，仿佛前方不是艰难险阻，而是唾手可得的通天仙途。
content_en:
The Qingyun Mountains have stood forever, among the misty clouds, and the cranes chirping clearly, carrying the sun through the clouds.
Today is the grand ceremony for the Qingyun Sect, a giant in the world of immortality, to open a mountain and recruit disciples once every ten years.
The huge square paved with white marble outside the mountain gate is already buzzing with people. Thousands of young girls with dreams of immortality are eagerly looking forward to it. Their eyes are all blazing towards the huge giant that looks like it reaches the sky - the Qingyun Staircase, also known as the Wenxin Staircase.
The nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine white marble stairs wind up and disappear into the vast sea of ​​clouds. At the end, you can vaguely see the glazed tiles of the Xianjia Palace reflecting the skylight.
This step is an extraordinary stone step. It contains the heavy pressure laid down by the sect's great powers and the disillusionment formation directed at the true heart. It is specially designed to test the mind, perseverance and potential of the seekers. It is the first step for the Qingyun Sect to select disciples, and it is also the ruthless iron threshold with the highest elimination rate.
There has never been one person in a hundred who has been able to reach the top. They are all the best among men, and their future is limitless.
At the edge of the square, a figure who was incompatible with the solemn, tense and exciting atmosphere around him was squatting in the corner, concentrating on tinkering with a simple small earthen kiln.
It was a girl who looked to be about fifteen or sixteen years old. She was wearing a white washed and even loose cloth clothes. An ordinary wooden hairpin tied her hair randomly, and a few disobedient strands of hair hung down by her ears, swaying gently with her movements.
Her brows were lively, and she was carefully placing a few strange leaves with red edges and weak heat on the bottom of the earthen kiln, muttering in her mouth:
"Hmm... The leaves of the 'Blazing Grass' that are about three hundred years old have a warm and long-lasting fire power and a sweet aroma. The roasted potatoes are charred on the outside and tender on the inside, and the spirit is not lost... Tsk, the big sect has a rich heritage. They are so particular about the weeds used as landscapes at the entrance. If you don't pick them up... No, if you don't borrow a few pieces, you will be sorry for this God-given opportunity."
She skillfully buried several dark red tubers about the size of a baby's fist covered in fresh soil into the earthen kiln, and lit the flaming grass blades on fire.
Soon, a strange sweet fragrance mixed with a touch of fire spirit filled the air, forming a strange but inexplicable harmonious contrast with the serious and expectant atmosphere in the square.
Several young people around who were waiting for the assessment couldn't help but glance sideways with disdain and confusion on their faces.
When did this happen? Are you still engaging in these food and drink cravings now that Xian Yuan is here? And what is that? Where did it come from?
A young man dressed in moiré brocade and wearing a jade pendant with faint aura on his waist couldn't help but snorted coldly, his tone full of superiority and disgust: "Hey!
That who!
Are you here to participate in the Qingyun Sect's assessment or are you here for the outdoor teeth-beating ceremony? This is the important place of the Immortal Family, it is solemn and solemn, please pay attention to your appearance and behavior!
This is really unreasonable! "
The girl raised her head when she heard the sound, her cheeks were already bulging (I don't know when she had eaten one secretly), she blinked a pair of clear eyes that always seemed to be a little sleepy, and said vaguely: "Appearance? Behavior? Brother, you don't understand this, do you? Only when you are full can you have the strength to climb the stairs!"
This is real physical work!
Look at you, you are so thin-skinned and tender-flesh, don’t cry from hunger later.
Want one? The freshly baked ‘Ley Vein Potatoes’ are rich in the spiritual energy of fire and earth and are fragrant! "
She handed over a tuber that was roasted black and stained with plant ash in an extremely natural manner, as enthusiastic as a street vendor.
That young man in brocade clothes was raped by that worrisome-looking "charcoal block"
Startled, he took two steps back as if he was afraid of being contaminated by poverty, and said in disgust: "Who wants to eat your dirty food of unknown origin?
I don’t know what it means!
A country girl with no decency! "
The girl was not annoyed, she shrugged and retracted her hand very naturally, "Click"
He took a big bite and gasped because it was so hot, but he narrowed his eyes with a satisfied look on his face: "Oh, wild boar can't eat fine chaff, so it's not a good thing to eat."
The young man in brocade clothes turned red with anger, and was about to scold him again, but was struck by a sudden sound that resounded through the square, as grand and silent as an ancient bell.Ming's voice interrupted.
"Quiet!"
A middle-aged monk wearing the blue robe of a deacon of the Qingyun Sect, with a clumsy face and eyes as cold as lightning, appeared silently on the high platform at the front of the Qingyun Ladder.
A pin drop could be heard instantly in the square, and all the noisy discussions were quietly suppressed by an invisible pressure.
"The Qingyun Ladder opens, and the heart of inquiry appears!"
The monk's voice was not loud, but his words were clear and struck everyone's heart, "Only those who reach the top before sunset can enter the next round of assessment!
You are not allowed to use magic tools or talismans on the way, and you are not allowed to fight or support each other. Anyone who violates this rule will be expelled immediately and will never be tested again! "
"Ascend the ladder—begin!"
The words are like falling rocks into a lake, causing thousands of waves!
The crowd, already ready to go, was like a raging torrent opening its gates, screaming and rushing towards the long white marble staircase.
The passion and ambition are burning at this moment, as if the road ahead is not difficult and dangerous, but a path to heaven that is within easy reach.
